scope: Complete chapter 6 author support: all 376 fixed source objects S1052–S1427 / 132 pairs MTP-000321–MTP-000452 reviewed. Records cover provisional terms and non-obvious grammatical applications; routine canonical repetitions and ordinary function words are excluded.
policy: Compact records group actual source loci. All provisional usages remain proposed; canonical glossary unchanged. Unrendered unresolved Tibetan remains in translator notes rather than receiving an invented lexical gloss. Uncomplicated repeated canonical terms and ordinary function words are not separately inventoried.
